tokens.name: brand-pink
tokens.usage: Fluorescent pink spot ink, the primary brand color. Same in both themes. In the UI, reach it through `accent`; use it raw only in brand moments (logo, splash, onboarding, stickers).

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Riso blue spot ink, the second brand color. Brand layer only: the overprinted logo, splash and stickers, always overprinted with or beside pink. Never text, never thin lines, never map pins. In the UI use `role` instead.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Ink black. The printed black of the zine. Same in both themes; UI surfaces and text reach it through `surface` and `text`.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Paper off-white. Same in both themes; UI surfaces and text reach it through `surface` and `text`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: paper in light, ink in dark. The theme follows the device setting.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, cards and the post composer, always outlined with `border`. Depth comes from the outline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Inputs, wells and the empty state behind a loading clip. Use `text` or `text-secondary` on it, not `text-muted`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy, titles and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk`.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy (park city, post date, obstacle notes) on any surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders and metadata on `surface` and `surface-raised` only (fails 4.5:1 on `surface-sunk` in light).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Ink rules and outlines: cards, sheets, inputs, outlined chips and buttons. Draw at `stroke-rule` for controls and `stroke-hairline` for list dividers.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers that carry no meaning, such as between comment rows. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one UI accent: primary button fill, selected tab and toggle, active filter chip, obstacle tag chip fill, map pins. Always a fill with `on-accent` on top, never pink text or a pink outline on paper.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` fills, in both themes (6.1:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Pink when it has to be text or a thin mark: links, an unread dot, a focused-field label. Darker in light so it reads on paper.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Pale pink tint behind a picked choice in a multi-select, such as disciplines in onboarding. The same pale pink in both themes, so in dark mode picked choices are the brightest thing on screen. Always keep the `stroke-rule` outline in `border` and a check mark, so the tint is never the only signal. Text on it is always `on-accent-subtle` and `on-accent-subtle-secondary`, never `text` (which turns to paper in dark). Checkboxes on it are `accent` fills with an ink outline and an ink check, in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent-subtle`, in both themes (ink, about 16:1).

tokens.name: on-accent-subtle-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text on `accent-subtle`, in both themes (about 7.5:1).

tokens.name: role
tokens.usage: UI version of riso blue, kept darker for legible text. Its single job is role badges (city admin, park admin, contributor). Always a fill with `on-role`.

tokens.name: on-role
tokens.usage: Text on `role` badge fills (5.9:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a solid 2px ring in `text`, offset 2px. Ink on paper, paper on ink; pink is not used because it fails 3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: status-open
tokens.usage: Park status 'Open'. Text and outline of an outlined status chip on any surface; always with the word, never a dot alone.

tokens.name: status-seasonal
tokens.usage: Park status 'Seasonal closure'. Outlined chip with the word.

tokens.name: status-closed
tokens.usage: Park status 'Temporarily closed'. Outlined chip with the word. Orange-red, kept clear of the brand pink.

tokens.name: status-soon
tokens.usage: Park status 'Coming soon'. Outlined chip with the word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive and moderation actions (suspend, ban, delete, hide a post): the outline and label of an outlined danger button, or the fill of the final confirm button with `on-danger`. Also the outline of an auto-hidden chip. Same values as `status-closed`; 5:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `danger` fill: paper in light (5.7:1), ink in dark (8.1:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Time-limited closures and cautions: the outline and label of an outlined chip such as a shop's 'Closed until Jan 7', and the outline and icon of a warning note in the web admin (another claim open on the same page). Always with words, never colour alone. Dark amber, kept clear of `status-seasonal` and `danger`. 5.2:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-on-ink
tokens.usage: Pink as text or a link on an ink block that stays ink in both themes, such as the park link on a page post card's ink strip or a link on the ink header. Lighter than `accent-text` so it reads on ink (9.7:1 on `brand-ink`). Never on paper.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets, in both themes. Flat ink at 60%, never a blur.

tokens.name: map-pin
tokens.usage: Park pins on Apple Maps and Google Maps, outlined in `map-pin-outline` so they read on both basemaps.

tokens.name: map-pin-outline
tokens.usage: Ink outline around park pins, in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Splash and onboarding headlines only. Uppercase.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Park name at the top of a park page. Uppercase; wraps to two lines for long names.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles, usernames on profiles and section heads. Uppercase.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card titles and list headings in sentence case.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Big, lit street and transition park with very smooth concrete.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines: park city, hours summary, post date.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips and badges (obstacle tags, status, roles). Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside list rows and small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a park page or profile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top spacing above display titles.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Onboarding and splash breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner: buttons, chips, cards, sheets, inputs, avatars and media. The system has no rounded corners.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: List dividers, in `border` or `border-subtle`.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Outlines of cards, sheets, inputs, outlined chips and buttons, and the focus ring.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable, for use outdoors and with gloves.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default interface icon size.

tokens.name: bar-row
tokens.usage: Height of the pinned ink bar's row on screens with a big header (park, brand and shop pages), below the top safe-area inset: `tap-min` tiles with `space-2` above and below. The bar is `brand-ink` with `brand-paper` text in both themes, so the status bar stays light.

tokens.name: control-web
tokens.usage: Web only: height of buttons, inputs and selects, and the size of square icon buttons. Admin screens are used with a mouse and keyboard at a desk, so controls drop from `tap-min` to 40px.

tokens.name: row-web
tokens.usage: Web only: minimum height of a table row in the admin queue and other admin tables.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Web only: width of the admin sidebar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Web only: maximum width of a single-column admin page (settings, a report on its own page).

tokens.name: detail-pane
tokens.usage: Web only: width of the detail pane beside the queue list in the split view.

tokens.name: split-min
tokens.usage: Web only: the narrowest viewport that shows the queue list and detail pane side by side. Below it, a row opens the detail as its own page, and below 768px the sidebar becomes a top bar.
